description: Three clearly distinct topics; boundaries are where the subject changes.

utterances.text: Okay so the election results are finally coming in from the swing states tonight.
Pennsylvania is still counting mail ballots and the margin there is razor thin.
The polling averages had this race within two points for the entire final month.
Turnout in the suburban counties looks way higher than anybody projected.
The exit polls suggest younger voters broke heavily toward the challenger this cycle.
Every network is refusing to call Arizona until the rural precincts report.
Senate control comes down to three races and two of them go to a runoff.
The incumbent governor conceded about twenty minutes ago in a pretty short speech.
Campaign spending in this state alone was over four hundred million dollars.
Redistricting is the story nobody covers and it decided half these House seats.
The margin in the county that always predicts the winner flipped by nine points.
Ballot measures on minimum wage passed in states the challenger lost outright.
Pollsters are going to spend the next four years explaining this miss again.
Voter registration drives in the cities clearly moved the needle here.
The concession speech avoided every question about the primary challenge.
Down ballot races are where the actual governing power sits and nobody watches them.
Alright, the new patch dropped this morning and the balance changes are insane.
They nerfed the shotgun damage falloff by thirty percent across every range.
The sniper rifle got a scope glint added which basically kills the whole playstyle.
Movement speed while aiming down sights is slower now in every single loadout.
The developers buffed the support class healing rate but capped the ammo regen.
Ranked matchmaking is completely broken because the skill rating reset again.
My whole build is dead, the perk it relied on got removed from the game entirely.
The hitbox on the heavy armor was oversized for two seasons and nobody noticed.
Server tick rate is still sixty and that is the actual problem with the netcode.
They added a new map but it is just the old map with the middle lane widened.
The battle pass grind got longer while the experience per match went down.
Every pro player in the scene is complaining about the recoil pattern change.
Controller aim assist versus mouse input is going to be the whole meta discussion.
The patch notes do not even mention the audio bug that has existed since launch.
Weapon attachments now have diminishing returns which nobody asked for.
Competitive playlists get the changes two weeks after casual, which is backwards.
Anyway I am starving, let me actually cook something on stream for once.
I am doing a garlic butter pasta because it takes about twelve minutes total.
Salt the water heavily, it should genuinely taste like seawater before the pasta.
The trick is finishing the noodles in the pan with a ladle of the starchy water.
Do not let the garlic brown or the whole sauce turns bitter immediately.
Fresh parmesan grated off the block, the pre shredded stuff has anti caking powder.
Reserve a cup of pasta water before you drain, everybody forgets this every time.
A little lemon zest at the end cuts through all the fat in the butter sauce.
Cast iron holds heat so much better than the nonstick for building a proper sauce.
Toast the black pepper in the dry pan first, it completely changes the aroma.
Cook the pasta two minutes under the box time because it finishes in the sauce.
Emulsify by shaking the pan, not by stirring, or the butter just splits on you.
Good olive oil goes on at the end off the heat, never into a screaming hot pan.
A handful of parsley at the very end for freshness and then it is done.
This entire dish costs about three dollars and beats most delivery honestly.
Let it rest thirty seconds in the bowl so the sauce tightens up before eating.
